name: ai-shared-responsibility
displayName: The Model Is Their Job. The Risk Is Yours.
description: A Built-in-the-Hive playbook: the AI shared responsibility model shows which duties the provider performs and which stay with the customer across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS. This shows professional-services teams how to map the split, own the duties that never transfer (identity, data governance, usage policy, accountability), and add the guardrails that make a stochastic model safer. Built on Microsoft Entra, Purview, Foundry, and Defender. An AI-literacy playbook.
